# Vendored emoji picker

This directory contains the browser runtime from `emoji-picker-element` 1.29.1
and the English Emojibase dataset from `emoji-picker-element-data` 1.8.0. The
files are served locally by `friend_server.py`; no CDN or internet connection
is required at runtime.

Upstream: <https://github.com/nolanlawson/emoji-picker-element>
